name: movement
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production transparent pixel-art sprite sheet of MARCO, the EXACT SAME bespectacled young male fighter from reference 1. Reference 1 defines identity and costume: short curly dark brown hair, rectangular dark glasses, light beige short sleeve school shirt over black long sleeves, small blue emblem on chest, charcoal blue jeans and dark low sneakers. Reference 2 only guides retro fighting game pixel density, bold dark outlines and crisp shading; do NOT adopt its black polo shirt, face, or muscular proportions. Preserve Marco's lean, slightly tall proportions and face across every frame.
OUTPUT: one 2048x2048 RGBA transparent sprite sheet, precisely FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 frames total, each cell 512x512. No background, no shadows on floor, no grid, no labels, no text. One full-body Marco per cell. Face screen RIGHT in 3/4 side fighting view, fixed camera, identical head/body scale in every cell. Whole figure always inside its own cell with at least 32px margins. Grounded shoe sole at local y=456, hips centered near local x=256. Normal standing figure about 392px tall. Leave transparent headroom. Crisp pixel art with 2-3px block clusters, no blurry antialiasing.
Each ROW is a distinct four-frame action, ordered left to right:
ROW 1 IDLE guard breathing cycle: 1 reference guard stance, 2 inhale/raise chest subtly, 3 guard bob downward, 4 return toward initial. Fists up, feet planted.
ROW 2 FORWARD WALK cycle while guarding: 1 front foot reaches right, rear heel lifts, 2 passing pose rear leg moves under hips, 3 other leg reaches right, 4 second passing pose. Clear alternating legs, keep guard.
ROW 3 JUMP ASCENT: 1 small compression preparing takeoff, 2 extending legs into takeoff, 3 knees bend under torso in ascent, 4 compact airborne pose knees tucked. Keep same anatomical scale; physics handles world translation, do not draw upward movement between cells.
ROW 4 FALL / LAND preparation: 1 knees tucked at apex, 2 extend legs downward, 3 feet ready to land with guard raised, 4 soft knee-bent landing. Match jump row identity and proportion.
NO ultimate attack or weapons. Every frame must be a coherent hand-authored animation key pose of Marco, not duplicate standing figures.

name: combat
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production transparent pixel-art sprite sheet of MARCO, the EXACT SAME bespectacled young male fighter from reference 1. Reference 1 defines face/costume: short curly dark brown hair, rectangular dark glasses, beige short sleeve school T-shirt over black long sleeves, small blue emblem on chest, charcoal blue jeans, dark sneakers. Reference 2 only guides bold outlined retro fighting game pixel art and crisp shaded clusters; do NOT borrow its face, muscular body, black polo. Marco is lean, slightly tall. Preserve identity, outfit, anatomical scale and palette across all frames.
OUTPUT: 2048x2048 RGBA truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 full-body frames, each isolated within its own 512x512 cell. No background, floor shadows, text, grid, labels, weapons, effects or ultimate. Facing RIGHT, fixed three-quarter side fighting view. Grounded shoe sole local y=456, hips around x=256. In standing guard he is about 392px tall; keep limbs/head that same size even in crouch. At least 24px clear padding; don't crop hands or shoes. Pixel art with bold 2-3px dark pixel clusters and 3-tone shading, no smooth illustration.
Each ROW is ONE distinct four-frame action in temporal order left to right:
ROW 1 CROUCH IN PLACE: frame 1 lowering knees and hips keeping guard; 2 deep low guard; 3 deep low guard breath; 4 deep guard settle. Clear low bent knees, no shrinkage of anatomy.
ROW 2 CROUCH WALK: four alternating low step poses, hips stay low, fists guarding face, knees deeply bent, one foot reaches right, passing, opposite foot reaches, passing. A real low walk, no crawling.
ROW 3 STRAIGHT PUNCH toward screen RIGHT: 1 windup at shoulder with rear hand guarding; 2 arm and fist fully extended horizontally RIGHT at chest height with clear impact silhouette and torso twist; 3 retract arm halfway; 4 recover guard. Whole body present, front foot fixed. Anatomically correct fists and elbows.
ROW 4 FRONT KICK toward screen RIGHT: 1 lift knee high and lean torso back slightly; 2 extend raised leg horizontally RIGHT at opponent waist/chest height with dark shoe furthest right, balanced supporting leg; 3 bend knee to retract; 4 return to guard with feet planted. The KICK must differ dramatically from a punch; clearly visible extended leg and foot.
Keep face/glasses/hair readable and consistent. Natural coherent fighting key poses, not 16 duplicate guards.

name: reactions
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production transparent pixel-art sprite sheet of MARCO, the EXACT SAME bespectacled young male fighter from reference 1. Marco has short curly dark brown hair, rectangular black glasses, light beige short sleeve school shirt over fitted black long sleeves, small blue chest emblem, charcoal blue jeans, dark sneakers. Lean slightly tall build. Use reference 2 ONLY for retro fighting-game pixel density/bold outlines/shading, never its black polo, muscular proportions, face or identity. Preserve Marco's identity and costume across all cells.
OUTPUT 2048x2048 RGBA genuinely transparent sprite sheet, exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 isolated full-body animation keyframes. Cell size 512x512. No text/labels/grid/background/floor shadows, no ultimate or weapons. Fixed camera, facing RIGHT in three-quarter side fighting view. In standing guard body height ~392px with soles at cell local y=456. Constant anatomical scale in all frames: do NOT enlarge crouched or fallen figure. Hips around local x=256. Keep ALL body parts in their own cell, at least 24px empty margins.
Crisp retro pixel art, thick 2-3px pixel outlines, limited 3-tone shading per material, NO smooth painted illustration.
Each ROW is one four-frame action in time order left to right:
ROW 1 BLOCKING: 1 raising both black-sleeved forearms, 2 tight guard arms crossed protecting face and chest, 3 lean back under blocked impact keeping guard, 4 settle into tight guard. Fully standing, knees slightly bent. No impact effects.
ROW 2 HIT REACTION: 1 head recoils left and shoulders twist from front hit, 2 pronounced backward recoil torso bends with painful face, 3 recover balance one step, 4 regain usual guard. No blood, injuries or stars. Preserve glasses.
ROW 3 KNOCKOUT FALLING: 1 knocked backward with arms open and knees buckling, 2 body tilting backward to screen left nearly horizontal, 3 down onto left side with knees curled, 4 fully lying unconscious on back/side horizontally on ground soles still within cell. Same-size head and anatomy, long horizontal body at bottom of cell, actual fallen poses, no standing at last frame.
ROW 4 VICTORY CELEBRATION: 1 relaxed upright guard with smile, 2 one clenched fist raised above head, 3 both fists raised triumphantly, 4 proud one-fist-up victory pose. Keep head size and anatomy the same and fit raised hands inside cell. Feet planted on baseline. This is a simple celebration, NO aura or special ability.
16 coherent hand-drawn key poses of the same Marco.
